asr.full_text: Guys, this just dropped and my minds is spinning. Breaking right now.. US military brass just stood in front on Congress and basically admitted BTC isn't just money, it's a weapon.. I'm talking 4-star admiral Samuel Papparo, head of US Indo-Pacific Command They're already running Bitcoin note. NOT starting it! RUNNING IT!! Let me break it down for you. First, watch the bitcoin chart right now this rally is weird no crazy leverage funding rates or flats to negative shorts are getting wrecked by sure spot buying it's not the usual hype cycle something bigger is moving behind the scenes what is happening the dollar is cracking the uae straight up told trump's administration give us dollar swap lines or we selling oil in u1 now let me explain what that really means because this is huge dollar swap lines are basically emergency lifeline from the federal reserve if a foreign countries like the ae use run shoots on u. dollars, they can call FEDS and borrow billions instantly. That lets them keep paying for oil trade and international deals in dollors without panicking. It's how the U.S. keeps the whole world hoaged. When the UAE say give to the swap line or we switching to Yuan, they basically threatened to ditch the dollars completely. That's not just talk, that's a direct challenge to America's financial powers. And here's where it gets wild. Treasury secretary Scott Bessons didn't just ask for crypto rules, he said the quiet part out loud he told Congress We need to lead on digital assets to protect the dollar status as a reserve currency. Not to help you and me to keep the dollars on top. Now, pause with me for a second. Why does all this matters to your everyday life? Because the money systems we've been living under isn't just about prices at the grocery store, it's quietly reshaping our communities, turning everything into something you can buy and sell including the spaces where people used to connect! That's why this Bitcoin moment feels different. It's not just about getting rich, it's about choosing different systems. One where you actually owns the assets. No middlemen. No permissions needed. The military gets it. The treasury gets it. Now it's your turn. Admiral Poparo yesterday you testified that Bitcoin held potential as a tool for national security. Recent research from the Bitcoin Policy Institute estimates that China has approximately 194,000 bitcoins while the United States has approximately 32 194,000 Bitcoins while the United States has approximately 328,000 Bitcoins. In this era of digital competition, would it be to our strategic advantage to maintain a lead in this regard, as we do with other strategic resources like gold and oil? Sir, our interest in Bitcoin is as a tool of cryptography, of blockchain, and reusable proof of work as an additional tool to secure networks and to project power. And so I think this protocol is here to stay. I think the computer science of it has direct implications for the projection of power, not financial, but from a computer science standpoint, from the securing of networks, and so I am supportive of those applications. All instruments of national power are important, but from the military application standpoint, my interest in Bitcoin is as a computer science tool as projection of power. I appreciate that, I agree with you. And I'd also like to hear your thoughts on monetary competition over the coming decades. What role does bitcoin play in spreading digital property rights? Steven Wolfhardt Well, people use bitcoin today, right now, to protect their own intellectual property, and that's the reusable proof of work protocol that's combined with blockchain for accountability and cryptography for security and so that's the role that i see for it i see direct national security implications and then i'm supportive for anything that maintains our own uh dollar dominance worldwide i appreciate. Do you think we're adequate adequately prepared to counter China's strategic direction regarding digital assets? I think that our recent act with the genius act is a great step forward that moves us in that direction. Lastly I'll ask you, as we continue to craft the NDAA, what authorities and resources does INDOPACOM need to address, as respects the national security dimensions of digital assets presently we're in experimentation so i'll give you a deeper look into that presently we have a node on the bitcoin network right now we're not mining bitcoin we're using it to monitor and we're going to we're doing a number of operational tests to to secure and protect networks using the bitcoin bitcoin protocol i appreciate that admiral thank you i yield back mr chairman wow let that sink in for a second the highest ranking commanders in the indo-pacifics just told congress that bitcoin's reusable proof of work is a direct tools for protecting national power. They are not mining. They're running live nodes and testing the exact same protocols that secure the networks for every one of us. This is the moment Bitcoin graduates from financial assets to strategic infrastructures in the eyes of the US military, and notice how carefully he said it. He's not talking about price. he's talking about cryptography, accountabilities and power projection. that's not retail hype. that's nation states recognition. dropper comments did this testimony change how you see bitcoin and what one thing you're doing in real life to build actual communities outside of all these online noises? I'm watching this unfold live for you, this isn't just another pump. This might be the beginning of somethings way bigger. Now Stay sharp out there.
